description: This file implements a function to report available files by loading a fetcher configuration from specific JSON files in the current or home directory, within the context of the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

classes.name: FetcherConfig
classes.description: A class representing the configuration of fetcher files, with a method to load configuration from a file.

methods.name: AvailableFilesReport
methods.description: Returns a FetcherConfig object populated with data from fetcher_config.json files located in the current directory or the user's home directory.
